_comment: Per-cart manifest for the bundled Galaxian clone, picked up automatically from the <cart>.voxbox.json sidecar convention.
name: galaxian (bundled)
controls: two shots on screen at a time
_camera: Slightly lower and tighter than the engine default: the action fills the whole deck, and a shallower angle makes the formation read as hanging above it.
_groundZ: Left to auto-derivation, which lands on the deck at z=50.
_persistGlobals: None needed: the cart stores its hiscore through cartdata/dget/dset like a real Voxatron cart would.
